description: This file defines a base class for AI services within the Pipecat framework, including model management, settings handling, and frame processing lifecycle methods.

classes.name: AIService
classes.description: A base class for all AI services in the Pipecat framework, providing core functionalities such as model management, settings handling, and frame lifecycle processing.

methods.name: set_model_name
methods.description: Sets the AI model name and updates related metrics.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Placeholder method to start the AI service, to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Placeholder method to stop the AI service, to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Placeholder method to cancel the AI service, to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: _update_settings
methods.description: Updates the service settings based on provided configuration, handling session properties and model settings.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes a frame and calls the appropriate lifecycle method based on frame type.

methods.name: process_generator
methods.description: Processes frames from an async generator, handling error frames separately.
